schemes.ApiKeyHeader.description: "**Default.** Send the API key as the value of the `Authorization` header, either bare (`Authorization: <your_api_key>`) or with the Bearer scheme (`Authorization: Bearer <your_api_key>`). Works on every endpoint, GET and POST alike.\n"

schemes.ApiKeyQuery.description: "Alternative to the `Authorization` header. Send the API key as `?api_key=...` in the query string, or as `api_key` form data on a POST request. If a key is supplied both ways on the same request, the query/form value takes precedence over the header.\n"
